_notes: Defaults for the proposed trip-blog feature (docs/travel-blog-architecture.md). Engineering placeholders using typical-website-practice figures, pending finance/legal ratification before launch — not yet wired into any running code. Byte values use 1024-based (GiB/TiB) units.
adminCeilingNote: Hard platform ceiling for admin-selected tiers (see open question 3 in docs/travel-blog-architecture.md). Admins may self-select any tier up to this ceiling without Stripe checkout, via an audited action; they never exceed it.
addOnNote: Tiered per-block pricing (improving per-GB rate at higher blocks), mirroring Google One rather than flat per-GB metering. Stacks additively on top of the account's tier-included bytes.
